key.name: dock-position
key.description: Dock position on screen: TOP, RIGHT, BOTTOM or LEFT.

key.name: extend-height
key.description: Extend dock to full screen width or height (panel mode).

key.name: dock-margin
key.description: Margin in pixels between the dock and screen edges when not in panel mode.

key.name: dash-max-icon-size
key.description: Maximum size in pixels for application icons.

key.name: icon-padding
key.description: Padding in pixels inside each icon container button (0 to 24px).

key.name: preferred-monitor
key.description: -1 for primary monitor, 0 or greater for specific monitor index.

key.name: multi-monitor
key.description: Show dock on all connected displays.

key.name: isolate-monitors
key.description: Show only applications present on the current monitor.

key.name: isolate-workspaces
key.description: Show only applications present on the current workspace.

key.name: click-action
key.description: Action on clicking an app icon with running windows (CYCLE, MINIMIZE, FOCUS, PREVIEWS).

key.name: middle-click-action
key.description: Action on middle-clicking an app icon with running windows (CLOSE_ALL, NEW_WINDOW, MINIMIZE, TOGGLE_FULLSCREEN, NONE).

key.name: shift-click-discrete-gpu
key.description: Launch application on discrete / dedicated GPU when Shift-clicking the icon.

key.name: scroll-action
key.description: Action when scrolling over the dock (NONE, CYCLE, SWITCH-WORKSPACE).

key.name: scroll-speed
key.description: Multiplier for mouse wheel scrolling speed across dock icons (0.2 to 3.0).

key.name: show-apps-at-top
key.description: Place the Show Applications button at the start instead of the end.

key.name: show-app-names
key.description: Show application name tooltips when hovering over dock icons.

key.name: show-show-apps-button
key.description: Show or hide the Show Applications button.

key.name: animation-time
key.description: Duration of slide animations in seconds.

key.name: hide-delay
key.description: Delay in seconds before hiding the dock.

key.name: show-delay
key.description: Delay in seconds before showing the dock on hover.

key.name: background-opacity
key.description: Dock background opacity between 0.0 and 1.0.

key.name: keep-pinned-apps-in-grid
key.description: Display pinned and favorite applications in the application grid and inside folders.

key.name: enable-spring-load
key.description: Activate and bring applications to the foreground when hovering over their dock icon with a dragged item.

key.name: spring-load-delay
key.description: Delay in milliseconds before bringing the application to the foreground on drag hover (200 to 1500 ms).

key.name: show-notification-badge
key.description: Dormant key for backward compatibility.

key.name: notification-badge-style
key.description: Dormant key for backward compatibility.

key.name: running-indicator-style
key.description: Style for running app indicators: DOTS (multi-window dots), LINE (continuous pill), DASH (compact dash), GLOW (ambient glow).

key.name: running-indicator-color
key.description: Color scheme for indicators: SYSTEM (sync with GNOME accent color), BLUE, TEAL, GREEN, YELLOW, ORANGE, RED, PINK, PURPLE, SLATE, WHITE.

key.name: window-preview-style
key.description: Preview menu appearance: THUMBNAIL (live visual window clones) or LIST (classic text list).

key.name: window-preview-size
key.description: Width in pixels of window preview thumbnails (140px to 360px).
